core: DNA double-strand break sensing and repair
name: Double-strand break sensing, NHEJ and protein ADP-ribosylation
rationale: All members concern the cellular response to DNA double-strand breaks; unlike the resection/homologous-recombination confusables, this theme centres on break sensing, NHEJ, PARP-type ADP-ribosylation and repair-site chromatin remodeling.

name: Cytochrome P450 steroid, vitamin D and retinoic acid metabolism
rationale: Members are CYP-catalysed syntheses and catabolism of steroid hormones, calcitriol and retinoic acid (with their inherited CYP defects); the vitamin D/retinoid arm separates it from steroid-only confusables and the steroid arm from vitamin A/K confusables.

core: Dendritic cell-driven CD4 T cell activation
name: Dendritic cell maturation, T cell costimulation and Treg differentiation
rationale: Members cover dendritic cell differentiation/activation and the costimulation, proliferation and Treg/Th17 fate of CD4 T cells they prime, distinguishing it from NK/tolerance and negative T cell regulation confusables.

name: SUMOylation of nuclear substrates, chromatin and transcription cofactors
rationale: Every member is SUMO conjugation to a class of nuclear target proteins; unlike confusables it lacks SUMO processing/E1-E2 steps and includes chromatin-organization and transcription-cofactor substrates.

name: Pancreatic ductal/endocrine lineages and kidney epithelial morphogenesis
rationale: Members describe later maturation of pancreatic ductal and endocrine lineages plus kidney and branching epithelial morphogenesis, unlike confusables on early endoderm, salivary or lung epithelium.

qualifier: aortic and coronary vascular smooth muscle
name: Cardiac growth and aortic/coronary smooth muscle development
rationale: Members concern developmental growth of heart muscle and smooth muscle of the aorta and coronary vessels, distinguishing it from cardiomyocyte proliferation/regeneration, endocardial/trabecular and adult VSMC phenotypic-switching confusables.

name: LDL/HDL remodeling and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein clearance
rationale: Members are remodeling and clearance of circulating lipoproteins; LDL/HDL remodeling and LDL clearance distinguish it from confusables centred on chylomicron assembly/remodeling and lipase activity.

name: Copper ion import, transport and detoxification
rationale: All members concern copper handling, whereas confusables cover general metal-response, metallothionein, zinc or cadmium handling.

core: Toll-like receptor sensing of bacterial ligands
name: TLR2/4/5 bacterial ligand sensing and MyD88 signaling
rationale: Members cover LPS, lipoteichoic acid and lipopeptide detection by surface TLRs, MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies and downstream inflammatory signaling, distinguishing it from NOD, inflammasome and cytokine-regulation confusables.

name: Nicotinate and NAD+ salvage and turnover
rationale: Members concern nicotinate metabolism, pyridine nucleotide salvage and NAD+ breakdown, unlike the de novo tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ and CoA/nucleotide confusables.

name: SREBP-activated cholesterol biosynthesis gene program
rationale: Members are SREBP activation of cholesterol-synthesis genes and SREBF-target motif modules, distinguishing it from cholesterol efflux/negative regulation, ChREBP, ATF6 and fatty-acid confusables.

name: SWI/SNF (BAF) and CHD-family chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Most members are assembly or action of BAF, CHD, NuRD and ChAHP remodeling complexes, distinguishing it from histone methylation and nucleosome assembly/acetylation confusables.

name: OCT4/SOX2/NANOG pluripotency and definitive endoderm specification
rationale: Members span pluripotency-factor regulation, gastrulation EMT and definitive endoderm/foregut specification, distinguishing it from lateral mesoderm, primitive streak and pancreatic-lineage confusables.

name: PTEN post-translational control and AKT signaling
rationale: Members concern AKT activation and targets, phosphoinositide synthesis and PTEN stability/localization, distinguishing it from confusables on PTEN translational (ceRNA) control, PAK-2p34 and inositol pyrophosphates.

name: cAMP suppression via adrenergic, cholinergic and adenosine receptors
rationale: Members are adenylate cyclase inhibition and cAMP degradation downstream of alpha-2 adrenergic, muscarinic/nicotinic and adenosine/purinergic receptors, distinguishing it from cAMP synthesis/PKA activation and serotonin receptor confusables.

name: Suppression of proinflammatory cytokine production and IL-10 regulation
rationale: Members are negative regulation of IL-6, IL-12, IL-1 beta and TNF production plus IL-10 regulation, distinguishing it from TLR-, NF-kappaB- and T cell cytokine-regulation confusables.

name: Mechanoresponsive stromal fibroblast extracellular matrix signatures
rationale: Members are ECM, EMT and fibroblast/stromal expression modules including YAP/TAZ-responsive matricellular programmes, distinguishing it from integrin, fibronectin and cell-migration confusables.

name: Integrin and collagen receptor binding of extracellular matrix
rationale: Members combine ECM modules with integrin interactions, fibronectin matrix formation and collagen-activated receptor signaling, distinguishing it from stromal, elastic-fiber and complement ECM confusables.

name: Endothelial shear-stress sensing and integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion
rationale: Members cover PIEZO1/PECAM1 shear-stress signaling and integrin-dependent leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, distinguishing it from diapedesis, neutrophil migration and T cell surface confusables.

name: Actin filament polymerization, severing, capping and crosslinking
rationale: All members concern assembly, disassembly and network organization of actin filaments, distinguishing it from lamellipodium/leading-edge, focal adhesion and filopodium confusables.

name: Cohesin-mediated sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading, cohesion establishment/maintenance and separation of sister chromatids, distinguishing it from spindle, replication, condensation and nuclear envelope confusables.

name: Coagulation cascade, fibrinolysis and inherited clotting factor defects
rationale: Members are coagulation, fibrin formation/dissolution and defective F8, F9, FV, VWF and FXII variants, distinguishing it from platelet activation and protease/matrix degradation confusables.

core: Small GTPase control of membrane traffic
qualifier: ARF/Rab regulation of endocytic recycling and Golgi export
name: ARF/Rab GTPase regulation of endosomal recycling and Golgi export
rationale: Members concern ARF and Rab GTPase regulation of endosome tubulation, recycling, Golgi budding and constitutive secretion, distinguishing it from Golgi-lysosome transport and Golgi structure confusables.

qualifier: NMDA, AMPA and kainate receptor activation
name: NMDA, AMPA and kainate glutamate receptor activation
rationale: Members concern activation, assembly and trafficking of all three ionotropic glutamate receptor classes, distinguishing it from confusables on NMDAR-to-CREB signaling, memory and synaptic plasticity.

name: Satellite cell maintenance and inhibition of myogenic differentiation
rationale: Members are negative regulation of myoblast/myotube differentiation and muscle development with satellite stem cell maintenance, distinguishing it from pro-myogenic fusion/proliferation and atrophy confusables.
